reason: The immediate goal is to switch the station to reserve, so the charged battery and power selector seem the direct way to do it.
expectation: I expect the emergency reserve to power essential cabin systems, with the fuel plant shut down.

alternatives.reason: The heat store could protect the garden, but establishing reserve power seems more urgent.

effect: The battery now supplies isolated essentials, but the reserve goal has not yet cleared.
reaction: The result is reassuring, though I am curious what else the reserve needs.
reason: The heat store belongs in the protected growing nook to help keep the garden warm.
expectation: I expect the stored heat to be placed in the nook for the plants.

alternatives.reason: The service trench may need attention, but its specific purpose is less clear to me.

effect: The nook is buffered by the heat store, so I can move the plants into it.
reaction: That is a sensible use of heat saved earlier.
reason: I want the potato trough protected inside the warmed nook.
expectation: The supported potato trough will move into the nook.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce also needs shelter; I chose the potatoes first without a strong preference.

effect: The potatoes are sheltered; the lettuce remains to be moved.
reaction: It worked as expected, with little additional detail.
reason: The lettuce trough should share the protected nook.
expectation: The lettuce will be sheltered there too.

effect: Both troughs are sheltered, leaving the service trench as the only offered gameplay action.
reaction: Moving the second trough felt repetitive, although its purpose was clear.
reason: I will use the tool on the trench because it is the only available combination; I am unsure what adjustment it makes.
expectation: Perhaps it isolates or checks the water line as part of the reserve plan, but I am guessing.

effect: The trench action drained the water line and completed the reserve plan; the pump and thaw checks remain on essential power with the inlet closed.
reaction: The explanation made the previously opaque tool action understandable and gave the reserve plan a concrete consequence.

mostWorthwhile.text: Draining the line and learning how the pump and thaw checks fit the reserve plan made the station's response feel practical and connected to the earlier water system.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs separately was clear but repetitive, with little feedback beyond their new names.

surprise.text: I did not anticipate that using the service tool on the trench would drain the line; the result explained the inlet and thaw checks.

arbitrary.text: The service tool and trench pairing lacked a clear purpose before I selected it, though the result clarified it.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the station and discovery fare after the power decline. The practical reserve response gives the situation stakes, though the trough moves themselves were fairly routine.
